By

Published on September 29, 2026 at 8:04 am CDT

Birmingham Mayor Randall Woodfin, Birmingham City Schools officials and community partners recently unveiled the Birmingham Children and Youth Commission’s Cradle-to-Career Report and Roadmap, a new initiative focused on investing in the city’s youth from early childhood through young adulthood.

According to city officials, the framework represents a new citywide strategy to connect fragmented programs into a unified system aimed at improving educational, enrichment and career-readiness outcomes for Birmingham children and young people.

“This is about changing the trajectory of a child’s life,” Woodfin said. “Where a child is born should never determine where that child ends up. We have talented people, strong institutions and tremendous community organizations doing the work every day. Now, we have a roadmap to connect that work, align our investments and hold ourselves accountable for results.”
